translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Since Gui served as tutor, whatever he said was nothing but the language of the age of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties; nothing touching mere fashion ever left his lips, and his counsel was abundant.

sentences.zh: 揆諸諡法，足當'正'字而無愧，特諡文正。

translations.literal: Measured by posthumous standards he fully merits the character 'upright' without shame—specially given the posthumous title Wenzheng."
translations.idiomatic: Measured by the standards for posthumous titles, he fully merits the character for 'upright' without shame—he is specially given the posthumous title Wenzheng (Cultured and Upright)."

sentences.zh: 又見其門庭卑隘，清寒之況，不減儒素。

translations.literal: Also seeing his gate and courtyard narrow and his circumstances of clean poverty no less than a plain scholar's.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also saw that his gate and courtyard were humble and his circumstances of austere poverty no less than those of a plain scholar.

sentences.zh: 」命內府備筵，遣皇子加奠。

translations.literal: " He ordered the inner court to prepare a feast and sent princes to add libation.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the inner court to prepare a feast and sent princes to offer additional libations.

sentences.zh: 啟殯日，遣慶郡王永璘祖奠目送。

translations.literal: On the day the coffin was opened he sent Prince Qing Yonglin to offer libation as chief mourner and see him off.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the coffin was opened, he sent Prince Qing Yonglin to offer libation as chief mourner and see him off.

sentences.zh: 逾年，上謁西陵，珪墓近蹕路，遣官賜奠。

translations.literal: A year later the emperor visited the western tombs; Gui's tomb was near the imperial route and an official was sent to grant libation.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, when the emperor visited the western tombs, Gui's tomb lay near the imperial route, and an official was sent to offer libation.

sentences.zh: 高宗實錄成，特賜祭，擢長子錫經為四品京堂。

translations.literal: When Gaozong's veritable records were completed a special sacrifice was granted and his eldest son Xijing was promoted to fourth-rank capital office.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianlong's veritable records were completed, a special sacrifice was granted, and his eldest son Xijing was promoted to fourth-rank capital office.

sentences.zh: 二十年，復因謁陵回鑾，親奠其墓，恩禮始終無與比。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, again on returning from the tomb visit, he personally offered libation at the tomb—favor from start to end unmatched.
translations.idiomatic: In 1820, again on returning from a tomb visit, the emperor personally offered libation at his tomb—favor from beginning to end unmatched.

sentences.zh: 珪文章奧博，取士重經策，銳意求才。

translations.literal: Gui's literary works were profound and broad; in selecting scholars he valued classical examination essays and earnestly sought talent.
translations.idiomatic: Gui's writings were profound and learned; in selecting officials he valued classical examination essays and earnestly sought talent.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年典會試，阮元佐之，一時名流搜拔殆盡，為士林宗仰者數十年。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he presided over the metropolitan examination with Ruan Yuan assisting; famous men of the time were nearly all selected, and scholars revered him for decades.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 he presided over the metropolitan examination with Ruan Yuan assisting; nearly all the leading men of the day were selected, and the scholarly world revered him for decades.

sentences.zh: 學無不通，亦喜道家，嘗曰：「硃子注參同契，非空言也。

translations.literal: His learning had no field he did not master; he also enjoyed Daoism and once said: "Zhu Xi's commentary on the Cantong qi is not empty words.
translations.idiomatic: There was no branch of learning he did not master; he also took an interest in Daoism and once said, "Zhu Xi's commentary on the Cantong qi is not empty talk.

sentences.zh: 論曰：君子小人消長之機，國運系焉。

translations.literal: The comment says: The mechanism of the waxing and waning of gentlemen and petty men—the nation's fortune depends on it.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: The rise and fall of gentlemen and petty men is a matter on which the nation's fortune depends.

sentences.zh: 王杰、董誥、硃珪皆高宗拔擢信任之臣，和珅一再間沮，卒不屈撓。

translations.literal: Wang Jie, Dong Gao, and Zhu Gui were all ministers Qianlong selected and trusted; Heshen repeatedly obstructed them, but in the end they did not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie, Dong Gao, and Zhu Gui were all ministers whom Qianlong had selected and trusted; Heshen repeatedly obstructed them, yet in the end they did not bend.

sentences.zh: 一旦共、驩伏法，眾正盈朝，攄其忠誠，啟沃新主，殄寇息民，苞桑永固。

translations.literal: Once Heshen was executed, upright men filled the court; they poured out their loyalty, counseled the new sovereign, destroyed bandits and rested the people, and the state was secure as mulberry roots.
translations.idiomatic: Once Heshen was executed, upright men filled the court; they poured out their loyalty, counseled the new emperor, crushed the rebels and brought peace to the people, and the dynasty stood firm as a rooted mulberry.

sentences.zh: 天留數人，弼成仁宗初政之盛，可謂大臣矣。

translations.literal: Heaven left several such men to help accomplish the splendor of Renzong's early rule—they may truly be called great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven preserved these few men to help shape the splendor of the Jiaqing Emperor's early reign—they may truly be called great ministers.
